decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, Proposed Block, LM/001A REVA, Received 23/02/2016
Amended unnumbered drawing dated 21/4/16 by Green Retreats, Received 22/4/16
Flood Risk assessment Received 23/2/16 
 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the south east elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - The detached single storey outbuilding must only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house known as number "28 Blenheigh Road, Chiswick, W4 1ET and for no other purpose.  A purpose incidental to a dwelling house would not cover commercial uses or normal residential uses, such as separate self-contained accommodation nor the use of an outbuilding for primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, or kitchen
description: Erection of an outbuilding in rear garden for use as a Gym
